Concept 04 / Multi-brand advertising campaign

WE ARE
DUTCHEST.

Five Dutch brands. Five familiar situations. One shared expression of everyday Dutch life—told through surreal, object-led still-life photography.

BRANDS   HEMA · PostNL · Tikkie · Coolblue · ASMLFORMAT   Five executions / One visual system

The idea.

What makes a brand unmistakably Dutch? Not a flag or a windmill, but the little ways it fits into daily life.

Each execution starts with its own brand promise, connects it with a quiet because, and lands on the same campaign statement: WE ARE DUTCHEST.

The approved five-panel artwork is presented intact above, with no duplicated headlines or additional text placed over the original layouts.
